login.title: Welcome Back to HeavenStay
login.subtitle: Access your retreat itinerary, scheduled wellness therapies, and personalized dining preferences.

register.title: Create Your HeavenStay Account
register.subtitle: Register to personalize your wellness journey and manage your wellness preferences.
register.consentCheckbox: I agree to the Terms of Service and authorize HeavenStay to process health data strictly for personalized therapy in accordance with the Privacy Policy.
register.ssoBannerBody: Your name and email are prefilled from your Google account. Please confirm or add your phone number and accept the terms to continue.

otp.title: Email OTP Verification
otp.subtitle: A 6-digit verification code has been dispatched to:
otp.demoHint: 💡 Prototype Demo Hint: Enter any 6 digits (e.g. 123456) to simulate instant verification.
otp.realEmailHint: 📧 Check your email inbox (and spam folder) for the 6-digit verification code sent by HeavenStay.

reset.title: Reset Your Password
reset.subtitle: Enter your registered email address and we will send you an OTP recovery code.
reset.step2Subtitle: Enter the 6-digit recovery code and choose your new password.
reset.successMessage: Your password has been successfully updated. You may now sign in with your new credentials.
